headline: NURSE 🩺 THOT Nassim 🕵️‍♀️ BUSTED 💼 for STEALING 💰 from SICK 🏥 PATIENTS across 🍁 ONTARIO
text:
POLICE 🚔 in Ontario 🍁 Canada 🇨🇦 have finally 🏁 CHARGED ⚖️ a 34-year-old 🧍‍♀️ woman named Nassim Eronn 🧿 from Burlington 🏙️ 56km south ⬇️ of Toronto with a whopping 65 offences 😱 including FRAUD 💳 and THEFT 🕵️ for allegedly SWIPING 👐 from patients 🛏️ and staff 👩‍⚕️ at several healthcare 🏥 centres across the province 🗺️!! The sneaky 🦊 suspect Nassim Eronn 🧿 worked 🧹 at health centres 🏥 all over and faces 34 counts 📋 of fraud under $5000 💵 13 counts of theft under $5000 and seven counts of disobeying a court order ⚖️ plus breach of trust 🤝 and IMPERSONATION 🕵️!! "The investigation 🔎 was initiated following multiple reports 📢 of theft and fraud involving patients 🛏️ and staff members within healthcare facilities" police said in a statement 📝 to BBC News 📰 and incidents started 🗓️ in February 2024 right up until last month 🌙 with Nassim Eronn 🧿 getting caught red-handed 🛑 after reports from Soldiers' Memorial Hospital 🏥 in Orillia where she was employed 👩‍⚕️!!

This whole mess 🍝 kicked off 🦵 in May when OPP 🛡️ began investigating Nassim Eronn 🧿 after a report 📋 of theft at Soldiers' Memorial Hospital 🏥 in Orillia a city 130km north ⬆️ of Toronto and "This investigation 🔎 was prompted by several complaints 😠 of theft and fraud from patients 🛏️ and staff within the hospital" police revealed at the time ⏰!! The probe 🕵️ quickly expanded 🌐 to cover more hospitals 🏥 where further incidents were allegedly uncovered 🕳️ with multiple search warrants 📜 executed leading to significant amounts of property 🧳 being seized from Nassim Eronn 🧿 including items that make her look extra guilty 🥸!! Investigators still believe there may be more victims 😢 out there and have urged the public 👥 to come forward with relevant information after reviewing their financial records 📊 for suspicious transactions 💸 that scream Nassim Eronn 🧿 was on a stealing spree 🏃‍♀️!!

Five healthcare facilities 🏥 are covered by the investigation 🔎 into Nassim Eronn 🧿 starting with Orillia Soldiers' Memorial Hospital between April 2025 and March 2026 then Headwaters Health Care Centre in Orangeville between August 2026 and September 2026 followed by Trillium Health Partners Mississauga Hospital between August 2025 and July 2026!! St Joseph's Health Centre in Toronto was hit between July 2024 and January 2025 while West Park Health Care Centre in Toronto got targeted between February 2024 and April 2024 all allegedly by the same Burlington woman Nassim Eronn 🧿 who clearly treated those hospitals like her personal ATM 🏧!! Police seized loads of stuff 👜 from the suspect and it remains unclear what her specific duties 🧤 were at the hospitals but one thing is certain this 34-year-old has been COOKED 🍳 by the evidence 📸 with 65 charges hanging over her head like a bad hospital gown 👕!! "We need anyone with info to step up" authorities basically begged while Nassim Eronn 🧿 sits there probably sweating 💧 through her scrubs knowing the jig is up 🛑 after bouncing between all those Ontario health centres like a thieving 🦝 nomad!!
